title: Domain Intelligence Input
description: Pass a list of domains. Returns WHOIS, DNS records (A, MX, NS, TXT), and inferred signals (email provider, DNS provider, SPF/DMARC presence) per domain.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: List of root domains. Plain domains or full URLs both accepted. Example: ["acme.com", "https://www.example.io"].
domains.sectionDescription: One domain per row, up to 10,000 per run.

includeWhois.title: Include WHOIS
includeWhois.description: Pull registrar, creation date, expiry date, organization, and country via RDAP. Adds one HTTP request per domain.

includeDns.title: Include DNS records
includeDns.description: Pull A, MX, NS, and TXT records via system DNS resolver.

includeDmarc.title: Check DMARC policy
includeDmarc.description: Look up the DMARC TXT record at _dmarc.<domain> and report presence and policy (none, quarantine, reject).

concurrency.title: Concurrent lookups
concurrency.description: How many domains to process in parallel. Default is fine for most runs.
